args.subject: Marrow Agrisupply handover
args.body:
Hi Tobias,

Handover notes for Marrow Agrisupply:

- Eastbank door-label mismatch (ticket PD-4821): the receiving-door import file labels doors E1/E2, but the store's booking sheet uses 01/02. Sort the labels out before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicate doors. Hollis owns setup/support.
- Pine Crossing missing afternoon shift: the appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 and the receiver wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis was to check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login. No ticket number found.
- Feature request FR-882: custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for their seasonal fertilizer sheds. Support routed it to the product backlog for Q2 review (per Moss's Central handoffs digest, 2 Jan 2026).

I can't see anything confirming the first two are fixed. Don't mark either store "ready" until someone has made a test booking.
